object.attr: derived: CF-S39, CF-S41, D29, review Q18. The path test alone lets .git, a short name such as DOCUME~1, a device name such as CON and a non-ASCII name through, and a UNC name touched before the check sends the user's credential hash to its host. Decided on 2026-11-10 (Q-S8).
object.description: If text given to Mellon as a document ID isn't a document ID, Mellon shall refuse the request without accessing a file or folder the text names.
